notes.title: Patch Release! Fixes And More
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released an update that addresses some issues that have been reported to us.

[h1]Fixes and changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]The lifeboats at the rear of the ship now appear. Previously many of them were not visible

[*]The multiple smaller staircases on the lifeboat deck now work correctly. If you went over them you fell through

[*]The player should now move even more smoothly throughout the interior spaces

[*]The footstep interval has been changed so it is more realistic
[/list]

If you are enjoying the game, please remember to leave a review! It helps alot.

Our upcoming game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2848550/Fall_Of_The_MS_Estonia/

[h3]Interactive Gaming Studios[/h3]

notes.content:

notes.title: Interior Update Released! [MAJOR UPDATE]
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just released the major interior update for Titanic: FOAL! This update will allow you to see both Titanic's interior (select parts from F to A deck) and exterior as it sinks. When in the third class corridors, be careful as if the water rises too far it will block your exit off. You may underestimate how much time you have left, as the front of the ship begins to sink first, so be careful! We have also reduced the jump height so clipping is lowered. The multiplayer mode has temporarily been disabled due to a few issues. Please note multiplayer won't include the interiors.

notes.title: MASSIVE Update! Multiplayer, new mode and fixes!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We have just uploaded the new Titanic: FOAL update! This update includes multiplayer, a new daytime sinking mode and the pause menu being more functional.

[h1]Multiplayer:[/h1]

The multiplayer addition lets anyone set up a server with 15 slots. Please note that upon creating the server the game begins immediately, and you may still join servers that have progressed into the sinking. In addition to this, the controls for multiplayer are different then singleplayer. As we are using a 3rd person character, you can't use A, D or S to control your character. You can still use W, shift and spacebar to control them. To use the chat in-game, press Alt to free your mouse and this allows you to click on the chatbox to begin writing messages. Pressing Alt again will make your mouse disappear. You can also remove the chatbox from your screen by clicking Alt, then clicking the "Chat" button on your screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/142b5142dc616ec53f2e85e63a36675986a22e6d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/fe164f980a6e551354429c3f3d84202687a1cf74.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/4540dbfc7ab36b57c09d49db89839aaeb4f09bf1.png[/img]

[h1]New Mode:[/h1]

As some players have requested, we have added a daytime sinking mode. This is essentially the same as the nightime sinking mode, but providing things in a different way. So we now have a nightime sinking mode, daytime exploration and daytime sinking mode.

We have also made the pause menu more functional, so the menu now freezes instead of moving around.

If you are enjoying the game, please leave a review! It helps alot.

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios[/h1]

notes.title: Daytime Explore Mode + Patch!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We just released an update for Titanic: FOAL! This new update includes a new daytime explore mode as well as a patch. We added a "Change Level" button so you can choose whether to do the sinking experience or the daytime explore mode. The patch consists of making the pause menu properly functional. We also included a option to return to the main menu, or to exit to the desktop.

[b]If you are enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review, it helps out alot![/b] 

We would also like people's opinion on adding a daytime sinking mode (this will essentially be the same as the night sinking but occurring during the day). If you haven't received the update, restarting Steam will allow the update to show up for download.

notes.title: Update Status - Multiplayer And More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have been working on releasing the first update for Titanic: FOAL and we would like to share with you where we are at. As you know, multiplayer is currently in development and is getting closer to release! Anyone will be able to create a multiplayer server, which will host 15 players at once. The entire simulation will then start to play out as soon as the server is created. We will also update the game with a daytime explore mode with this next major update!

Thank you for your patience, it is greatly appreciated. If you are enjoying the game, please remember to write a review as it helps out tremendously!

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER COMING + RELEASE!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Welcome to the first news post for Titanic: Fall Of A Legend! We have extremely exciting news to share with you regarding the game, and also talking about releasing.

The first huge update we want to share with you all is the game will be supporting multiplayer (as well as singleplayer). This is an exciting new development we recently decided to implement. We hope multiplayer will be ready for the release that is happening in 2 days. However, if not, we plan for it will be very soon after that! Servers currently hold up to 15 players, but this may be adjusted prior to release. We have a few work in progress screenshots of the multiplayer below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/2586dd66f41004f7de75436508aa40a00c97540d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/6c39f21e8a07dec560fb265e5a520e6a3b20e8dc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592668/86556462562ae944bc14755dd011632e91bb6fab.png[/img]

Regarding release, the game is set to release on February 11th at 2pm PST. If you would like to know the release in your timezone, please use a timezone converter that will help. On release, we will be monitoring the forums and reviews to ensure bugs are fixed ASAP, and any suggestions you may have. If you currently have questions, please post them on the forums or below on this post. We look forward to bringing you the game!

[h1]Interactive Gaming Studios[/h1]
